# sauth_app (Resource)

The app records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) app name
- `owner_id` (String) organization id that owns the app
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) redirect uris the app sends
- `slug` (String) app slug

### Optional

- `app_image` (String)
- `claim` (Object, Sensitive) the default claim granted on first login (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim))
- `connection` (String) how the app connects, code needs sync_uri, static keeps the session on the prophet for a site with no server
- `contact_email` (String)
- `cookie_domain` (String)
- `cookie_same_site` (String)
- `description` (String) app description
- `parent_id` (String)
- `provider_ids` (List of String) provider ids bound to the app organization
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) the app secret, checked against the stored one and never exported
- `status` (String)
- `style` (Dynamic) colors and background of the login page
- `sync_uri` (String) disciple url the disciple monitor kind probes; sync is pulled by the disciple

<a id="nestedatt--claim"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim`

Optional:

- `description` (String)
- `inherits` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `sa_access` (Number)
